scripts.build:native: npm run test && npm run build && cap sync
scripts.copy:builds: powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'release-builds' | Out-Null; if (Test-Path 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk') { Copy-Item 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk' 'release-builds/Fyrlinc-Debug.apk' -Force }; if (Test-Path 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk') { Copy-Item 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk' 'release-builds/Fyrlinc-Release.apk' -Force } elseif (Test-Path 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk') { Copy-Item 'android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release-unsigned.apk' 'release-builds/Fyrlinc-Release.apk' -Force }; if (Test-Path 'android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab') { Copy-Item 'android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab' 'release-builds/Fyrlinc-PlayStore.aab' -Force }"
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:native && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME='D:\android-tools\jdk'; $env:ANDROID_HOME='D:\android-tools\sdk'; $env:GRADLE_USER_HOME='D:\.gradle'; cd android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug assembleRelease -g 'D:\.gradle'" && npm run copy:builds
scripts.build:aab: npm run build:native && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME='D:\android-tools\jdk'; $env:ANDROID_HOME='D:\android-tools\sdk'; $env:GRADLE_USER_HOME='D:\.gradle'; cd android; .\gradlew.bat bundleRelease -g 'D:\.gradle'" && npm run copy:builds
scripts.build:all: npm run build:native && powershell -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME='D:\android-tools\jdk'; $env:ANDROID_HOME='D:\android-tools\sdk'; $env:GRADLE_USER_HOME='D:\.gradle'; cd android; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug assembleRelease bundleRelease -g 'D:\.gradle'" && npm run copy:builds
scripts.build:ota: npm run build && powershell -Command "if (Test-Path 'bundle.zip') { Remove-Item 'bundle.zip' -Force }; Compress-Archive -Path 'dist/*' -DestinationPath 'bundle.zip' -Force"
